output_list.reason: The mint function does not check for overflow, allowing the owner to mint an arbitrary amount of tokens to any user account, causing a depletion of the token supply.
The pullBack function does not check for overflow, allowing the owner to pull an arbitrary amount of tokens from any user account, causing a depletion of users' token balances.
The transferFrom function does not check if the spender is the contract owner, allowing any spender to transfer tokens from the owner's account, bypassing the owner's approval.
The approve function does not check if the spender is the contract owner, allowing any spender to transfer tokens from the owner's account, bypassing the owner's approval.
The mint function does not require the spender to be a buyer, allowing the owner to mint tokens to any address, facilitating a rug pull attack where the owner absconds with the funds.
